items.source: ComponentDefinition implementation that holds one or more nested ComponentDefinition instances, aggregating them into a named group of components.
items.translation: 实现 ComponentDefinition 以持有一个或多个嵌套的 ComponentDefinition 实例，并将它们聚合为命名的一组组件。

items.source: Return the configuration source Object for this metadata element (may be null).
items.translation: 返回此元数据元素的配置源 `Object`（可能为 `null`）。

items.source: Add the given component as nested element of this composite component.
items.translation: 将给定的组件作为此组合组件的嵌套元素添加。

items.source: Return the nested components that this composite component holds.
items.translation: 返回该组合组件所包含的嵌套组件。

items.source: name - the name of the composite component
source - the source element that defines the root of the composite component
items.translation: source - 定义组合组件根元素的源元素

items.source: the array of nested components, or an empty array if none
items.translation: 嵌套组件的数组，如果没有则为空数组。

items.source:
This should link back directly to the corresponding configuration data
for this component in a given context.
items.translation: 这应直接链接到给定上下文中该组件对应的配置数据。

items.source: Get the user-visible name of this ComponentDefinition.
